propositions: transition_close.py exceeds 800-LOC hard cap at 803 LOC, causing module-size gate CI to fail and blocking all Gerrit changes from reaching Verified +1

The completion-verification precheck cluster (_completion_precheck, _referencing_commit_exists, _is_live_ticket, _has_live_replacement_link, and _NON_COMPLETION_BUG_CLASSES) forms a closed call-graph seam suitable for extraction into a separate module without breaking behavior

Module imports and monkeypatching across tests depend on _completion_precheck being accessible as transition_close._completion_precheck, which must remain dynamically resolved by close_ticket to preserve interception behavior without code changes

Splitting transition_close.py into transition_close.py (~480 LOC) and transition_close_precheck.py (~340 LOC) along the precheck call-graph seam brings both files into the 100-800 LOC policy band and eliminates the CI gate failure
